item.title: The First Descendant Hotfix 1.4.5b
item.description:
Greetings, Descendants.

Here are the details of The First Descendant Hotfix 1.4.5b.

This patch will be applied without a client update, allowing immediate access without additional downloads.

For Descendants currently in-game, please return to the title screen and reconnect to apply the patch.

item.description:

  • Fixed alpha channel for the updated Cozy Camper backpack image
